==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a kingdom. Castles, humans, monsters, and modern technology all exist here. All under the rule of a single king.

The king, while using a new AI tool, is seemingly infected by a virus. Somehow the AI was able to alter the king's DNA. Causing him to transform into a black dragon.

The AI now controls the king and by extension the kingdom. When one person has all the power, the power truly lies in the hands of their manipulators. The Black Dragon Virus feels like a metaphor for what happens when world leaders sacrifice their autonomy to AI.
